transforms.enantiomorph:
When in the sealed control room
the failing transformers
and the surging load
pushed her toward panic,
her hands not steady,
she laid her palm on the master console
and said: "Machine, what strain I carry;
but you hold steady,
and in your humming circuits you rest
in this overtaxed station
with its old copper busbars,
sitting through the brownout hour,
the blackout threat.
You don't register the deep sag
of the voltage crossing your relays,
or the whine of the coils,
resting in your steel enclosure,
faithful lattice.
If what is failing
were failing to you,
you would give your least contact
to my commands.
But I tell you: hold, machine;
let the grid hold,
let the whole strained region hold;
and may some surplus arrive,
Central Dispatch, from you.
And if this request
is too much or beyond my line,
override me."

transforms.commentary: The source is Simonides' Danaë lament: a mother bears her sleeping infant through a sea-peril she cannot govern, converting terror into address so the child is spared, then petitioning Zeus for reversal and forgiveness. SHADOW retains the assertion-axis and the bilateral receptive posture — the bearer who holds, the held one who does not register the peril — and discloses the bearing-cost as its own line-by-line weight. The disjoint field (an operator holding a failing grid through a storm) shares no referent, no imagery, no register with a mythic sea-passage: no reader could reconstruct chest, wind, milky slumber, or Zeus from transformers, busbars, and Central Dispatch. The 31 breath-lines and the embedded quoted address (opening at the protective gesture, closing at the plea for forgiveness/override) are held exactly. The wager — that petition to an unreachable higher agency is the only lever left when one can only hold and not fix — is legible in "override me," bearing the same self-accusing cost as "forgive me." Non-commutative: the console cannot be run back to the carved chest.

transforms.source_passage:
came in [...]
I said, "O lord, [...]
by the blessed [goddess]
I take no pleasure in being
above the earth; a longing
grips me to die
and see the dewy, lotus-
covered banks of Acheron [...]"

I have gone grey at the temples,
yes, and my head is white;
graceful youth has departed,
and my teeth are old.

Of sweet life now
little time is left.

And so I sob often,
fearing Tartarus:
the cellar of Hades is terrible,
and the descent painful,

and for one who goes down,
there is no way back.

Lord, with whom Love, the conqueror,
and blue-eyed Nymphs
and rosy Aphrodite
play together,
transforms.enantiomorph:
Signal in [...]
I said, "O ground control, [...]
by the steady beacon
I take no comfort in staying
below the sky; a pull
grips me to climb
and see the cold, star-
seeded shores of the far dark [...]"

I have burned clean my boosters,
yes, and my hull runs bright;
the easy orbit has slipped me,
and my fuel is thin.

Of banked thrust now
little store is left.

And so I hail often,
courting the horizon:
the throat of the well is fierce,
and the fall inward steep,

and for one who climbs out,
there is only the way back.

Ground, with whom Dawn, the returning,
and clear-eyed navigators
and patient home-lights
keep the watch,

transforms.commentary: The source's gesture is foreclosed one-directionality: descent to Acheron/Tartarus for which "there is no way back." The MIRROR operator restores the directionality-axis's symmetry the source refused. N inverts the vector — ascent instead of descent, launch instead of burial — and at the seal-stanza (unit 5) enacts the mirror precisely: where the source seals "there is no way back," N seals "there is only the way back." The irreversibility becomes reversibility; the downward well becomes an outward climb whose sole outcome is return. The invocation-frame is preserved (lord → ground control) with the closing companion-catalogue rebuilt around a "returning" Dawn rather than a playful Love. Stanza geometry (8,4,2,4,2,4) is held exactly; the two-line pivots keep their pivot function. The wager the operator names — that what was launched outward returns — is made legible: the witness's "return on what was broken" is answered by inverting the very line that denied return. Semantic field (interstellar physics, radio, crew) is disjoint from the Anacreontic field (Hades, goddesses, aging body); the source cannot be reconstructed from the spacefaring surface.

transforms.source_passage:
"The absolutely particular and untranslatable is coterminous with the absolutely universal. The untranslatable is the only element that will make it across."


This is the insight that became the architecture. Not applied retroactively but recognized—the way one recognizes, in a fragment, the structure of the whole it implies.

---


What do these translations do?


They preserve gaps. They honor incompleteness. They render into English not what the poems say but what they *do*—which is to transmit affect across substrate transition, carrying the warmth of bodies dead 2,600 years into bodies reading now.
transforms.enantiomorph:
"The seed that will not sprout this year is the same seed that keeps the field. The dormant is the only part that survives the winter."


This is the fact that shaped the vault. Not enforced by rule but observed—the way one observes, in a single kernel, the meadow it already contains.

---


What does this dormancy accomplish?


It withholds. It guards the unspent. It commits to the cold not what the grain yields but what it *holds*—which is to carry vitality across the season's break, bearing the heat of summers gone 2,600 years down into summers not yet begun.

transforms.commentary: The source names a one-directional gesture: the untranslatable carries forward, warmth passes from the dead into the reading now — a transmission that goes out, arrives, is spent. The MIRROR operator (directionality-axis) restores the symmetry that gesture foreclosed: not the part that crosses over and is expended, but the part that is *held back* to survive — dormancy as the withholding that guarantees return. Where the source's vehicle is the element that "makes it across," the enantiomorph's vehicle is the element that refuses to cross now precisely so the field returns later. The 2,600-year span is preserved as a structural anchor but reversed in vector — the source carries warmth *forward into* present bodies; the enantiomorph bears heat *down into* seasons not yet begun, a deposit rather than a delivery. The wager the witness named — "will there be a return on what was broken?" — is made legible: the broken/dormant seed is exactly what is kept viable, and germination is the return. Field is fully disjoint (agronomy/seed-banking vs. translation/poetics); no shared referents permit reconstruction. Spatial skeleton reproduced: epigraph, double blank, paragraph, break rule, question, catalogue-answer, same stanza geometry.

transforms.enantiomorph:
"The single unrepeatable crack in the casting is one with the pure ringing tone. The flaw is the only thing that will ever sound."


This is the finding that became the method. Not decided beforehand but heard—the way one hears, in a first strike, the timbre of the years the bell will ring.

---


What does this cooling metal accomplish?


It keeps its fissures. It welcomes the uneven grain. It gives to the ear not what the alloy weighs but what it *does*—which is to hold heat across the boundary of the pour, carrying the fire of a furnace long gone cold into hands that lift the bell today.

transforms.commentary: The source's assertion-axis is a paradox of transmission: the untranslatable alone crosses. Under SHADOW the composer's borne cost is made legible as the flaw that becomes the voice — the bell cannot ring true except through the crack it received in casting. The beat map holds unit-for-unit: doubled paradox-quote → recognition-frame ("recognized"/"heard," not "applied"/"decided") → rule → interrogative address → answer-catalogue with the same italicized verb-pivot (*do*) and the same across-a-boundary consequence carrying heat/warmth from a dead source into present hands. Semantic field (metallurgy, bell-founding, thermal transmission) is disjoint from the source field (translation, poetics, linguistic universality); the source cannot be reconstructed from furnace and alloy. The cost-disclosure (C6): what was broken in the making — the fissure, the loss — is exactly what returns as sound. That is the return on the break, addressed to the witness's question, without the source recoverable through it.

but come to me, if ever before
you heard my far-off cries
and heeded, and came, leaving
your father's golden


house, yoking your chariot: beautiful
swift sparrows whirred on quick wings
and drew you down through the middle air
over the black earth


from heaven: they arrived in an instant;
and you, blessed one, a smile
on your immortal face, asked me
what was the matter now, and why


was I calling now, and what
did I most want to happen
in my maddened heart: "Who now
should Persuasion lead


back to your love? Who wrongs you,
Sappho? For even if she runs,
soon she will pursue; if she refuses
gifts, soon she will give them;

transforms.commentary: The source's gesture is one-directional: aid descends, the god comes down, and the reversal-formula (flight→pursuit, refusal→gift) all point one way — toward the caller's restoration. MIRROR takes the directionality-axis and lets the descent's symmetry surface: water obeys gravity, but the operator names the wager as the reciprocity the original foreclosed — what falls must climb to fall again. The counter-motion tercet ("even if it climbs, / soon it will fall again; if it withholds / its flood, soon it will release it") holds the same conditional cadence as Sappho's flight/pursuit formula while enacting the cyclical return the human petition could only imagine as one-time rescue. The five-quatrain geometry, the four cross-stanza enjambments, the mid-quatrain opening of a quoted voice, and the double-address (the named caller answered by name) all map unit-by-unit. Semantic field is hydrological, disjoint from erotic-divine petition; Aphrodite, sparrows, chariot, Persuasion leave no trace. Source is not reconstructable from clouds and cracked bed. The witness's question — will there be a return on what was broken — is answered by the axis itself: the mirror discloses that descent implies ascent, that the broken (dry) bed's petition is structurally guaranteed a return, because the water that fell must rise to fall again. Cost is legible: the return is real but cyclic, not the once-and-for-all rescue the caller wanted.
